rationale: The revision typechecks, lints, passes the end-to-end canary and every fast suite that does not require a built workspace checkout (383 passing; the 6 remaining files fail identically for every pin including my own, so they are a worktree artifact rather than a regression), it hardens each derived-decision schema so an identity must match its own input hash and round and cannot be carried on a record citing no inputs, and it preserves the fail-closed behaviour I approved of at comparison time, where a missing or stale canonical decision yields a typed wait with empty bindings and empty approved paths instead of falling back to roster position.
